name: Home & Living
seo: Settling in on Cebu: long-stay rentals and condo sales, furniture and homeware, cleaning services, and the tradespeople who fix an aircon or a leaking pipe the same week. Rentals are listed with district and price band; the maintenance side covers plumbers, electricians, aircon crews and contractors who answer the phone.

subSeo.Rentals: Long-stay houses, condos and apartments by district, with price bands and what is included.
subSeo.Condos & Sales: Brokers and developments for buying — condos, houses and lots across Metro Cebu.
subSeo.Furniture & Decor: Furniture, homeware and interiors, from mall showrooms to local workshops.
subSeo.Cleaning: House and condo cleaning, deep cleans and move-out services, by visit or contract.
subSeo.Maintenance & Repairs: Plumbers, electricians, aircon crews, contractors and hardware — the people who actually turn up.

items.name: NeatSpaces - Cebu
items.address: Unit 208, LiteCloud Building, Sanson Rd, Lahug, Cebu City, 6000 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: NeatSpaces - Cebu earns stellar reviews for its reliable, affordable, and amazingly thorough professional cleaning services. Clients highlight their easy communication, punctual staff, and meticulous attention to detail—from rearranging heavy furniture to leaving bathrooms squeaky clean and fresh-smelling. It is an ideal choice for both regular upkeep and deep cleaning, especially recommended for local Airbnb hosts looking to boost their ratings.

items.name: AGS Worldwide Movers - Philippines, Cebu City
items.address: B32 J. King Warehouse Complex A.C 6014 Mandaue City, A. C. Cortes Ave, Cebu City, 6014 Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: AGS Worldwide Movers in Cebu City delivers an exceptionally professional, stress-free relocation experience built on top-tier international standards. Key highlights include meticulous damage-free packing, swift customs clearance, proactive communication, and attentive crews who assist with assembly, cleanup, and even car washing. For expats moving internationally or transferring vehicles domestically, working directly with their local Cebu branch is a great practical tip for ensuring a seamless, on-budget move.

items.name: Asian Home Appliance Center - Moalboal
items.address: Moalboal, Cebu, Philippines
items.desc: Asian Home Appliance Center in Moalboal offers a welcoming, customer-focused atmosphere backed by fair pricing and great deals. Reviewers consistently praise the friendly and accommodating staff—including standout team members like Julius—who provide clear feature explanations and valuable maintenance advice. For the best experience, be sure to ask the knowledgeable team for personalized recommendations and care tips on your appliance purchases.
